reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Marktplaats documents a RESTful OAuth2 API (also 2dehands/2ememain) for placing/managing ads plus a Search endpoint; client credentials come from Marktplaats (business/advertiser use).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id assigned by Marktplaats (API clients are registered by the platform for business/advertiser use); grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.marktplaats.nl/accounts/oauth/token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret assigned with it. A client token reaches public resources (categories, search, advertisements) only.

config_fields.name: category_id
config_fields.help: Category id to restrict searches to (e.g. the cars category id from GET /v1/categories); without it `query` is mandatory.

adapter.terms: Marktplaats API (https://api.marktplaats.nl/docs/v1/): monetary amounts are euro cents; no deep pagination (offset*limit ≤ 5000).

search_listings.note: GET /v1/search?query&categoryId&postCode&offset&limit (limit ≤ 200, offset a multiple of limit, offset*limit ≤ 5000); query supports and/or and '-' negation; 400 query-missing when neither query nor categoryId is given. location is a 6-character Dutch/Belgian postcode. make/model/year/price filters are not query parameters (the documented price filter lives in a GET request body, which is not sent). priceModel.askingPrice is in EURO CENTS and stays in raw.

get_listing.note: GET /v1/advertisements/{itemId} (ids like m1234): title, description, categoryId, priceModel (euro cents), attributes and image links in raw.

not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN lookup in the Marktplaats API.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation endpoint in the Marktplaats API.
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory endpoint (only users/{id} for a known seller).
not_offered.me: GET /v1/me needs a user token from the authorization-code flow; this adapter uses a client token.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
